questions.question: Five people are sitting on a bench facing north. S is to the immediate left of R and to the immediate right of B. M is to the right of R. T is between R and M. Who is sitting to the immediate right of T?
questions.solution:
Given: Five people are sitting on a bench facing north.

1) S is to the immediate left of R and to the immediate right of B.

2) M is to the right of R.

3) T is between R and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2674f50d09126d348d98f534ef0db28197cb039fe3c881aee51893cccbf2193.png] 

Here, 'M' is sitting to the immediate right of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question:
Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing North. 

i. Q sits to the immediate right of P, who is at one of the extreme ends of the line. 

ii. Q sits third to the left of T. 

iii. There are two persons between W and T.

iii. U is not an immediate neighbor of S and sits to the immediate left of V. 

iv. There are three persons between V and R. 

Who are sitting between Q and T?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing North. 

1) Q sits to the immediate right of__** P, who**__ is at one of the extreme ends of the line. 

 
• *Here P is at one the extreme ends of the line not Q.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd0f9114fc2a44d9a386b622dc50735c2b452fca7a287ca0e8fd000b26aa04e3.png] 

2) Q sits third to the left of T and there are two persons between W and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab0f2030b04b4dba79563079cac6e08bc60efffce011afceae409458d4991c91.png] 

3) U is not an immediate neighbor of S and sits to the immediate left of V.

 
• *Here U sits to the immediate left of V.*

So there have two possibilities.

 There are three persons between V and R. 

Possibility 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/554f521b0252d24894dbdec59bf2ca873d17cc73a47acab54b71cb6f66fcff9b.png] 

Possibility 2) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a23a789d9528d607b904b283e8052ac00fdd9f8095e6c5a31d4ae4827853ba5.png] 

4) There are three persons between V and R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14b734eeabc8f2021678de15eb3684e7ea24c6e27d71b88beb6eb41d5b215c01.png] 

As we cannot draw three persons between V and R . So the second possibility is eliminated.

It is clearly seen that R and S are sitting between Q and T.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1"**.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**Meaning of Next to → के बगल में

Arranging them according to the given information,

1) Kumar is standing next to Raju, who is standing on the extreme left it means Kumar is standing next to Raju and Raju is standing on the extreme left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afcf9d762bcba22babccfbfe4e5e5ef7fc96cf63d2dfad94e5ee69e391e51e66.png]

Suman is standing in the middle in the line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

**"Who"** is used for the **second person** in a sentence.

For example,

Kumar is standing next to __**Raju, who**__ is standing on the extreme left → it means Kumar is standing next to Raju and Raju is standing on the extreme left. 

**"And"** is used for the **first person** in a sentence.

For example,

**Suman** is standing next to Pranav **but** not next to Deena → Suman is standing next to Pranav and Sumna is not next to Deena.

questions.question:
Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row, facing towards the north (but not necessarily in the same order). Neither C nor D is at the extreme ends of the row. H is at the extreme right end of the row. Only E is sitting between D and F. Only G is sitting between F and H. C and A are the immediate neighbours of B.Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. D is fourth to the left of H.

II. D is the immediate neighbour of B.
questions.solution:
Given: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) H is at the extreme right end of the row.

2) Only G is sitting between F and H.

3) Only E is sitting between D and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c27a1bf1cfa417d10a11302caf468c90e6f88788be745dd63765817d5923983d.png]

II. D is the immediate neighbor of B - False.

So, 'Only I' statement is true here.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
